name: Admissible Oriented One-Hole Cover
statement: A finite nonempty family is generated from a finite collection $\mathcal W$ of pairs $(y,B)$, $y\in Q_E$, $|B|\ge2$, by $H(\mathcal W)=\bigcup_{(y,B)\in\mathcal W}\{y^U:\varnothing\ne U\subseteq B\}$. The cover is admissible when no tip $y$ lies in the union, the antipodes $y^B$ cover the union, and $|\operatorname{Sh}(H(\mathcal W))|=|H(\mathcal W)|$.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty Boolean concept class, with coordinate reversals and permutations allowed.
comments: The canonical cover of a cornerless ample $H$ uses every nontrivial minimal nonface $B$ of the local cube-support complex $\Lambda_H(x)$, with datum $(x^B,B)$. The parametrization detects cornerlessness but does not by itself impose pc-minimality outside dismantlable ampleness.
